title: Personal Checking: Extended Overdraft Fees Booked at an Amount Other Than the Tier Figure
content:
## Rule

On Personal Checking, a booked extended overdraft fee is a bank error if its amount is not the extended overdraft fee set by the account's tier. The fee entry's posted amount is set against the tier's figure; a difference in either direction, however small, makes the fee an error.

## Judgement in brief

Condition — the amount on the extended overdraft fee entry differs from the tier's extended overdraft fee. Judgement — the fee was booked contrary to the tier schedule. Consequence — the fee is a bank error on this ground.

## Worked comparisons (tier figure assumed at 20.00 USD for illustration)

| Amount booked | Matches the tier figure? | Bank error on this ground |
|---|---|---|
| 20.00 | yes | no |
| 30.00 | no | yes |
| 19.00 | no | yes |

## Q&A

**Can this ground apply when the debit that began the episode is unknown?** Yes. It rests on the booked amount and the tier figure alone.
